correctness.rationale: Let W_m,n=C_n join m mutually nonadjacent centers. For n>=4, distinct centers are mutually maximally distant (distance 2), so no two centers may be omitted; distinct nonadjacent rim vertices are mutually maximally distant (distance 2), so omitted rim vertices form either an empty set, singleton, or adjacent pair. This gives necessity. For sufficiency, pairs with a selected endpoint resolve themselves; omitted adjacent rim vertices are strongly resolved by a selected rim neighbor beyond one endpoint, and omitted center/rim pairs by a selected rim nonadjacent to the omitted rim via shortest selected-rim−center−omitted-rim path. Thus omitted center and rim choices are independent, giving (x^m+m x^(m−1))(x^n+n x^(n−1)+n x^(n−2)). Least exponent m+n−3, coefficient mn, total (m+1)(2n+1). When n=3,m>=2 all rim pairs and all center pairs are mutually maximally distant, so at most one omitted from each; another selected center resolves a mixed pair, giving (x^m+m x^(m−1))(x^3+3x²). The exceptional m=1,n=3 is K4 giving x4+4x3. Independent all-pairs BFS and exhaustive every subset for 15 cases m=1..3,n=3..7 matched all coefficients and bases; the proof is all-orders.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge original all-set strong-resolving classification, exact count of all bases and full size polynomial for the t-fold/generalized wheel. Explicitly excludes 2016 known scalar formula from novelty assertion.
residual_risks: An alternative multiple-hub wheel/t-fold wheel paper might enumerate all strong resolving sets but evade keyword searches.
The source’s known scalar strong metric dimensions are explicitly prior; acceptance is only for complete all-set profiles.
No claims for directed, dominant, fractional or rooted-product variants.

value.rationale: A family-wide polynomial enumerating every strong metric resolving set is a natural strengthening of prior work that determined only the dimension and constructed one basis. It determines all possible omission patterns and exact basis multiplicity mn, relevant to redundancy/robustness of metric landmark selection and is not a tiny numeric improvement.
